描述_EN: the ‘rice vessel’ series is inspired by the rice-eating tradition in chinese culinary culture. wang kezhen’s series is produced by a painstaking process: each silver ‘rice grain’ is hand made by honing; meanwhile a ceramic mould is made copying the form of a historic example of ceramic rice bowl; the silver rice grains are then soldered together to from the shape of a vessel using the mould. wang kezhen’s work explores the concept of vessels. because of the importance of rice to chinese cuisine, historically, many special rice cooking and serving vessels have been invented and made with different materials, their forms catered to the need to contain rice grains.
描述_ZN: "米器 "系列的灵感来自中国烹饪文化中的吃米传统。 wang kezhen’s series is produced by a painstaking process: each silver ‘rice grain’ is hand made by honing; meanwhile a ceramic mould is made copying the form of a historic example of ceramic rice bowl; the silver rice grains are then soldered together to from the shape of a vessel using the mould. 王克振的作品探讨了容器的概念。 由于大米在中国烹饪中的重要性，历史上有许多特殊的煮饭和盛饭的器皿被发明出来，用不同的材料制成，它们的形式都是为了满足盛放米粒的需要。
